exact_result: Published BJ 2206.07183v2 supplies the genuine psh cone, intrinsic reference and envelope/normalized compactness on every smooth projective pseudoeffective numerical class over all algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero fields. Relative to the exact supplied ample theorem, this draft proves an actual original-carrier relative finite-energy equation for the explicit nonnef domain X=Bl_p(Y), L=pi*A+aE, Y smooth connected projective of dimension at least two, A an actual ample rational bundle, a positive rational, with V_L=a log|s_E|, raw mass vol(L)=(A^n), intrinsic quotient dual-energy targets, comparison, attained solutions and uniqueness modulo constants. Outer differentiation is proved for pulled continuous quotient directions only. The zero-volume equation range proved is only the actual trivial bundle in positive dimension; a bounded nef product example disproves blanket uniqueness of the zero top operator. The unrestricted original P16.5 axis remains unproved.
concrete_gaps: G1: For every actual big rational L, construct model-independent positive relative nonpluripolar products and actual original-carrier E1 with the intrinsic reference retained, raw volume/relative mass, and genuine unbounded decreasing closure.

G2: Prove full-domain relative mixed estimates, weighted continuity, locality, comparison/domination and two-sided outer-energy differentiation in every continuous original-carrier direction, with reference-preserving orthogonality.

G3: Prove full-domain intrinsic target integrability equivalence, coercivity, target continuity, actual finite-relative-energy attainment, identification of the genuine operator, and uniqueness modulo constants.
G4: Establish G1-G3 over every retained field and for arbitrary admissible support without complex-field, finite divisorial, finite-generation or fixed ample-contraction restrictions.

G5: For additional zero-volume pseudoeffective classes construct and prove an explicit replacement quotient/operator with its carrier, auxiliary datum if any, raw mass, admissibility and injectivity mechanism; no zero-mass probability division.
